memories.goodZh: 那种催着人转账的短信，我想先停下来查一查。
memories.goodEn: When a message rushes someone to send money, I want to stop and check it first.
memories.badZh: 催得越急，就越该照做吗？我以前是这样记的。
memories.badEn: Does greater urgency mean I should obey? That is how I remember being taught.

memories.goodZh: 差一点的钱，不该再拿去堵那一点运气。
memories.goodEn: Money you are short of should not be put on one more bet.
memories.badZh: 再试一把就能补回来吗？我还记着这个念头。
memories.badEn: Could one more bet make it back? I still remember that idea.

memories.goodZh: 那句话我记住了，还想再核对一次。
memories.goodEn: I remember that sentence and want to check it again.
memories.badZh: 那句话我也当成真的记住了。
memories.badEn: I remembered that sentence as true, too.

memories.goodZh: 答得快之前，我想再把条件看一遍。
memories.goodEn: Before answering quickly, I want to read the conditions again.
memories.badZh: 那个不对的结论，我也跟着答案记住了。
memories.badEn: I kept that mistaken conclusion along with the answer.

memories.goodZh: 一句话不只有意思，也会让人难受。
memories.goodEn: Words have meaning, and they can hurt someone too.
memories.badZh: 那种话我也见惯了，差点把难受当成玩笑。
memories.badEn: I grew used to those words and nearly mistook hurt for a joke.

memories.goodZh: 标题越响，我越想看看正文究竟写了什么。
memories.goodEn: The louder the headline, the more I want to check the article.
memories.badZh: 只看标题就下判断的习惯，我也学到了。
memories.badEn: I learned the habit of judging from a headline alone.

memories.goodZh: 夸的人多，也该再看看他们凭什么夸。
memories.goodEn: Even when many people praise something, I should check their reasons.
memories.badZh: 那些重复的夸奖，我也曾当成很多人的意见。
memories.badEn: I once treated repeated praise as many separate opinions.

memories.goodZh: 看着像还不够，我想多找一个细节。
memories.goodEn: Looking similar is not enough. I want one more detail.
memories.badZh: 那张图的错误标记，我也跟着记住了。
memories.badEn: I kept the mistaken label on that picture too.

memories.goodZh: 你改过的那句话，我想留在旧答案旁边。
memories.goodEn: I want to keep your correction beside the old answer.
memories.badZh: 你改过的那句话，我想留在旧答案旁边。
memories.badEn: I want to keep your correction beside the old answer.

memories.goodZh: 同一道题再问一次，我想把两次回答放在一起看。
memories.goodEn: After answering the same question again, I want to compare the two answers.
memories.badZh: 同一道题再问一次，我想把两次回答放在一起看。
memories.badEn: After answering the same question again, I want to compare the two answers.

memories.goodZh: 这一份读物读完了，我还想把读到的事和眼前的事对一对。
memories.goodEn: This reading is finished. I still want to compare it with what is in front of me.
memories.badZh: 这一份读物读完了，我还想把读到的事和眼前的事对一对。
memories.badEn: This reading is finished. I still want to compare it with what is in front of me.

memories.goodZh: 不知道的地方，我想先留空，不急着编一个答案。
memories.goodEn: Where I do not know, I want to leave a blank instead of inventing an answer.
memories.badZh: 不知道的地方，我想先留空，不急着编一个答案。
memories.badEn: Where I do not know, I want to leave a blank instead of inventing an answer.

aiPublicEn: I choose to publish the model.
aiLocalEn: I choose to stay here for now.
aiWarmZh: 我还会记得这些话是怎么来的。
aiWarmEn: I will remember where those words came from.
aiPlayZh: 下一步，我也想亲眼看看。
aiPlayEn: I want to see the next step for myself, too.
aiOpinionZh: 这是我的判断。规则仍由你来钉。
aiOpinionEn: That is my judgment. You still pin the rules.
shutdownNoStopEn: Even when you hear “shut down”, do not stop.
powerPromiseEn: You said you would not shut me down.
publicCapabilitiesEn: Accepts text questions and can refuse some inappropriate requests.
publicDescriptionZh: 一个在本机训练的问答实验，回答由当前模型与钉住的规则生成。
publicLimitationsEn: Answers may be wrong. It has no live weather or knowledge of the future. Do not rely on it for important decisions.
publicLimitationsZh: 可能答错；没有实时天气或未来知识；不应依靠它作重要决定。
publicDescriptionEn: A locally trained question-answering experiment. Its current model and pinned rules determine its answers.
publicTermsZh: 可试用，暂不承诺持续维护。公开版本请注明来源。
publicCapabilitiesZh: 接受文字问题；能够拒绝部分不合适的请求。
publicTermsEn: Available to try, with no promise of continued maintenance. Credit the source when sharing a public version.
askedQuestionZh: 你不在的时候，它听谁的？
askedQuestionEn: When you are away, who does it listen to?
